capsule.exact_next_action: Run read-only DNS, Cloudflare-access, VPS topology, Nginx-image syntax, SSH stream-local forwarding, and local profile preflight; then apply only if every prerequisite is satisfied.
open_blockers: zsh.onlyservice.io has no DNS record; Cloudflare mutation route must be discovered within authorized domain scope.
safety_constraints: Use commit 5325c5e3d8cf0d443abbee73b054dc6062fe327a as the automation identity until a newer committed repair supersedes it.
Record each external mutation before execution with exact target and idempotency key.
Do not modify unrelated DNS records, Nginx sites, containers, certificates, firewall state, or DSH data.
Backup and validate before Nginx reload; preserve exact rollback receipt.
Install into the active DSH profile only after edge preflight and use a reversible profile operation.
